<thought>Based on the clear M+1 peak (~12 % of the base peak) indicating the presence of carbon, and the pronounced M+2 peak (~33 % of the base peak) characteristic of chlorine’s ³⁷Cl isotope, the elements that can be definitively identified from the observed isotope pattern are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
